title: Combine Functions into Class

solutions.title: One TrainingBlock the sheet asks questions of
solutions.tradeoff: A class and a `new` where there were only functions, and a boundary that has to be defended: the renderer will want to move in, and it must not.

reviewFocus: Did every derived value move onto the class, or only the ones that were awkward to pass? A half-moved clump is worse than none.
Is the renderer still a function outside the class? If it moved in, what stopped the class from becoming the whole module?
Which methods are getters and which take a `week`? The split should follow what the value depends on, not what felt natural to type.
Does the class store the two records, or did it copy their fields onto itself? Copying is a second decision and needs a reason.
Is the rounding still in exactly one place, so that the printed total is the sum of the printed weeks?
